title: 3 ספרי ילדים שיעזרו להם לשתף פעולה

stage.need: Joining other children, helping, and doing one thing together. CDC lists 'Notices other children and joins them to play' by 3 years and 'Likes to be a helper' by 4 years, and says playing with others helps a child learn the value of sharing and friendship.
stage.age_caveat: CDC milestones describe what most children (75% or more) do by an age, not a deadline, and the two books are board books sold for toddlers and gan children with no numeric age. The slide headline says בגיל 3 with הרבה ילדים (Yarin cut בסביבות from the frame headline on 9 Oct); the caption says בסביבות גיל 3 and that some children need more time.

dev_sources.title: Milestones by 3 Years
dev_sources.publisher: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early.
dev_sources.quote: Notices other children and joins them to play / Encourage your child to play with other children. This helps him learn the value of friendship / Developmental milestones are things most children (75% or more) can do by a certain age.
dev_sources.supports: Slide 2: noticing other children and joining them to play is a listed social milestone by 3 years; milestones are what 75% or more of children do by that age, hence הרבה ילדים and the caption's בסביבות. Playing with other children helps a child learn the value of friendship.

dev_sources.title: Milestones by 4 Years
dev_sources.publisher: CDC, Learn the Signs. Act Early.
dev_sources.quote: Likes to be a “helper” / Playing with others helps you child learn the value of sharing and friendship. / Continue to teach your child skills to play with others, such as using words, sharing toys, and taking turns. / Read with your child. Ask him what's happening in the story and what he thinks might happen next.
dev_sources.supports: By 4 years most children like to be a helper; playing with others teaches sharing and friendship; reading together and asking what is happening and what comes next backs the 'how' lines. CDC does not say these books teach cooperation: the link from each story to the skill is our reading of the plot.

products.popularity_reasoning: Strong Israel-specific signal: 6th of 116 on Steimatzky's children's bestseller list today, plus in print at both national chains. Steimatzky's own blurb calls it a classic that generations grew up on; that is marketing text and was not counted.
products.developmental_relevance: Grandpa cannot pull the giant carrot out alone; grandma, the granddaughter, the dog, the cat and finally the mouse each join the line, and only together it comes out. Steimatzky's blurb names the theme: 'עזרה לזולת, התנדבות, שיתוף פעולה, וכוחה של הקבוצה הגדול מכוחו של היחיד'. Children can see each helper join and guess who comes next, which matches CDC's 'likes to be a helper' and its reading tip.
products.parent_tip_source: Our suggestion: pull a pillow together like in the story and ask who else can help. CDC 4 years: ask what is happening in the story and what might happen next.

image.rights_note: Steimatzky's product image (the page's og:image) of the board-book cover. No press or media licence on the page; the cover artwork belongs to the publisher and illustrator.

products.limitations: AGE NOT OFFICIAL IN NUMBERS: no publisher or retailer page gives a numeric age; the slide's גיל 0 עד 6 is our reading of the e-vrit genre label פעוטות וילדי גן, and Yarin should confirm or reword it. The Steimatzky page shows both an add-to-cart button and a hidden 'חסר זמנית' label, so its stock state is recorded as listed only; Tzomet shows a price and add to cart. Several editions exist (board book, 60-year edition, bath book); the cover shown is Steimatzky's board-book listing. I did not read the full text; the plot comes from the Steimatzky and Tzomet blurbs.

products.popularity_reasoning: Strong Israel-specific signal: 8th of 116 on Steimatzky's children's bestseller list today, plus in print from the Hebrew publisher and at both national chains.
products.developmental_relevance: Ofir sets out singing and one friend after another joins, each with something of their own (a teddy, a bell, a trumpet), until they are one noisy band marching together (Steimatzky and Tzomet blurbs: 'ואליו מצטרפים ... שכולם יחד מהווים מקהלה משעשעת'). It shows joining a group that is already doing something, which is CDC's 3-year milestone 'notices other children and joins them to play'.
products.parent_tip_source: Our suggestion: give each child something from the kitchen to drum on and march through the house like in the story.

image.rights_note: Steimatzky's product image (the page's og:image) of the board-book cover; the publisher's own cover image is only 252 px wide. The publisher page says '© כל הזכויות שמורות – הוצאת הקיבוץ המאוחד בע"מ'. No press or media licence seen.

products.limitations: The publisher files the board book under 'up to age 3' with no lower bound, so the slide says גיל 0 עד 3 (0 is implied, not printed); it suits the younger half of this stage. Sifriat Poalim was a publisher in a recent books carousel (maker warning). The link to cooperation is our reading of the plot (friends join one by one and make music together); the publisher's blurb speaks of 'הנאה, תקווה, אכזבה ותושייה', not of cooperation. I did not read the full text.

lumebook.connection: Second to last of 3 suggestions (2 books and the LumeBook book), in Yarin's format: ספר של LumeBook / סיפור מותאם אישית עם תמונות של הילדים שלכם שבו... The image is the homepage 3D book with the real photo of the child it was made from; the story line follows the carousel's topic (playing together), taken from the catalogue book ארגז הצעצועים המיוחד, where the child finds that sharing makes playtime more fun. Not the pictured book.

claims.wording_he: ספרי ילדים שיעזרו להם לשתף פעולה
claims.supports: CDC: by 3 most children notice other children and join them to play, by 4 they like to be a helper; reading together and talking about what happens in the story is CDC's own tip. That these stories help is our reading of their plots, worded as help, not as a result.

claims.wording_he: בגיל 3 הרבה ילדים כבר מצטרפים למשחק של אחרים
claims.supports: CDC 3-year social milestone: 'Notices other children and joins them to play'; milestones are what 75% or more of children do by that age, hence הרבה ילדים and the caption's בסביבות.

claims.wording_he: אפשר לדבר על זה תוך כדי קריאה
claims.supports: CDC 4 years: 'Read with your child. Ask him what's happening in the story and what he thinks might happen next.'

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים לראות איך כל אחד מצטרף ועוזר עד שביחד מצליחים
claims.supports: CDC 4 years: likes to be a helper; ask what is happening in the story. The plot (each one joins the pull until the carrot comes out) is from the Steimatzky and Tzomet blurbs.

claims.wording_he: מתרגלים להצטרף לחבורה ולשיר ביחד כשכל אחד מביא משהו משלו
claims.supports: CDC 3 years: notices other children and joins them to play; playing with other children helps a child learn the value of friendship. The plot (friends join Ofir one by one, each with something of their own) is from the Steimatzky and Tzomet blurbs.

claims.wording_he: סיפור מותאם אישית עם תמונות של הילדים שלכם

claims.wording_he: שבו הם מגלים שכיף יותר לשחק כשמשתפים
claims.supports: Catalogue book ארגז הצעצועים המיוחד (lumebook.com/IL/he/books/50, 2026-10-10): they discover that sharing makes playtime even more fun. Ties the LumeBook line to the carousel's topic; the pictured homepage book is only the example of the format.

notes: Voice: fallback (3 of 15 samples), written after Yarin's 9 Oct edits on books.html (שיעזרו להם in the hook, בגיל X without בסביבות in the frame headline, תשאלו instead of שאלו, one short why line where possible, a short caption with no product list, the close built as save line, question, ספרו בתגובות). Ranking source: Steimatzky 'רבי המכר לפעוטות ולילדים', first 40 of 116 positions read with curl and a browser user agent on 2026-10-10. Considered and dropped: שלשת הפרפרים (position 12, also Levin Kipnis and ספר לכל, so two books by one author), דירה להשכיר (position 32, outside the top 10 percent, and no Sifriyat Pijama page found), הבית של יעל (13, imagination more than cooperation). Sifriyat Pijama pages for the two picks were searched for and not found, so no Sifriyat Pijama signal is claimed. CDC pages were read through WebFetch; Steimatzky, Tzomet, e-vrit and the publisher page with curl.
